title: AgentCtl Permissions
description: Runtime-neutral permission definitions for agentctl. Lives at .ai/permissions.yaml. Uses deny-over-allow precedence.

version.description: Schema version. Omit or use 1 for the original blanket model; use 2 for path-level filesystem plus network/env/mcp sections.

policy.description: Precedence policy for resolving conflicting rules.

precedence.description: Deny rules always win over allow rules. This is the only supported precedence.

filesystem.description: Filesystem permissions. v1 uses blanket edit/write scalars; v2 may express read/write as path-level capability blocks.

edit.description: v1: blanket permission for editing existing files.

write.description: Permission for creating/writing files. Scalar (v1) or path-level capability block (v2).

default.description: Default permission for shell commands not matched by allow/deny.

allow.description: Glob patterns of shell commands to allow.

deny.description: Glob patterns of shell commands to deny. Deny wins over allow.

network.description: v2: network access control keyed by URL glob patterns (deny_over_allow).

env.description: v2: environment variable access control keyed by name glob patterns.

mcp.description: v2: MCP tool access control keyed by <server>:<tool> or <server>:* patterns.

permissionValue.description: Permission decision: allow, ask, or deny.

capability.description: A capability governed by a default decision plus optional allow/deny/ask pattern lists (deny_over_allow).
